talents.scene: the trainers' hall of a heroic order: a tall vaulted hall of warm sandstone with massive rounded arches and dark oak beams; along the right wall heavy weapon racks hold a greatsword, a war hammer, a staff, a longbow and a round shield; in the focal point a broad stone dais with a carved oak lectern holding a large open tome, lit by a tall arched window behind it through which warm late-afternoon light pours; stacked old books and a brass brazier near the dais; the left side is the shadowed stone wall of the hall with one tall plain hanging cloth banner.
talents.light: warm golden window light against cool violet-grey stone shadow; the open tome glows faintly.

classes.scene: a great hall of heroes: a long nave of pale stone with thick round columns; on both sides stand colossal stone statues of armoured champions on plinths — a knight with a greatsword, a robed mage with a staff, a hunter with a bow, a priest with a mace — seen in three-quarter view, all wearing closed helms or deep hoods so no faces show; at the far end, at the focal point, a tall arched doorway of light with a broad stair leading up to it; long plain cloth banners in deep blue, crimson and gold hang between the columns.
classes.light: a warm shaft of light from the far doorway and the upper-left clerestory against cool blue-violet shadow along the nave.

characters.scene: Icecrown Citadel seen from the frozen glacier below: the jagged dark saronite spires of the citadel rise on a sheer cliff of blue ice, the tallest central spire — the Frozen Throne — topped by a faint cold blue light; huge curved saronite spikes and chains frame the fortress walls; wind-driven snow, a broken glacier and a few toppled saronite spikes form the calm foreground; storm clouds part around the spire.
characters.light: cold moonlit ice-blue light on the spire against deep midnight-blue shadow; the only warm note is absent — the scene is cold.

auction.scene: the interior of the Orgrimmar auction house: a big hall of rough red-brown timber and hide with massive curved bone tusks and iron spikes holding up the roof, wide spiked iron braces and riveted metal plates; at the focal point a long goblin auctioneer's counter of dark wood with a big brass balance scale, stacked coin chests, sacks of goods and crates; above it a round opening in the roof lets warm light in; brass oil lanterns hang from chains; the left side is a shadowed timber wall with a stack of crates.
auction.light: warm copper-orange lantern and roof light against deep bottle-green shadow.

transmog.scene: the ethereal transmogrifier's wardrobe hall: a tall round hall of dark violet stone with brass trim; along the curved walls stand tall arched alcoves, each displaying an empty set of armour on a headless mannequin stand — gleaming plate, a mage robe, leather hunter armour — with folded cloaks and plain tabards on racks; at the focal point a tall freestanding arch of brass and violet crystal with a softly swirling teal-and-violet void mirror inside it; a pair of empty mannequin stands near it.
transmog.light: soft teal-violet light from the void mirror and warm brass lamplight against deep indigo shadow.

library.page: World of Warcraft Library (items, spells, records)
library.scene: the great library inside the Violet Citadel of Dalaran: a tall round chamber with curved bookshelves of dark wood climbing three storeys, connected by narrow wooden galleries and ladders; violet slate floor with gold inlay; at the focal point a tall arched window of leaded glass with violet-blue arcane light, before it a large brass orrery on a pedestal and a reading desk with open tomes and a single candle; the left side is a tall dark bookcase in shadow.
library.light: cool violet-blue arcane window light and a few warm candle accents against deep ink-blue shadow.

tierLists.scene: a commander's war room in a stone keep: a massive oak war table covered by a hand-painted map of a continent with coastlines, forests and mountains but no writing; carved wooden unit markers and small pinned flags stand on the map; tall plain heraldic banners without emblems in crimson, deep blue and gold hang from the beams in descending order of length like a ranking; a weapon rack and a tall arched window with dusk light behind the table at the focal point; the left side is a dark stone wall.
tierLists.light: warm dusk window light and a brazier glow against cool teal-grey stone shadow.

whatsNew.page: What's new (site news; World of Warcraft: Midnight era)
whatsNew.scene: Silvermoon City in Quel'Thalas seen from a high elven terrace at early morning: graceful white-and-gold elven spires with sweeping crimson-and-gold roofs, curved arching bridges, golden-red Eversong trees; far away a pillar of golden light rises from the Sunwell on the Isle of Quel'Danas over the sea; in the left foreground a shadowed carved white-stone balustrade and a hanging crimson cloth.
whatsNew.light: soft golden sunrise light against cool lavender-blue shadow.

season2.scene: the Isle of Quel'Danas at twilight during the Midnight war: the Sunwell plateau's golden elven spires rise on the island, a tall pillar of golden light shoots up from the Sunwell, while above it a huge dark violet void rift tears open the evening sky with purple storm clouds; the sea below reflects both gold and violet; elven ruins and a broken white-stone arch in the calm, shadowed foreground.
season2.light: golden Sunwell light against violet void storm light and deep indigo shadow.

prey.scene: a hunter's ambush point in the twilight forests of Eversong: a narrow forest path between tall golden-red elven trees, deep fresh claw marks gouged into a large trunk, a sprung iron hunting trap with a chain on the path, an arrow stuck in a tree, a hooded hunting cloak caught on a branch; at the focal point a small hanging lantern by the claw-marked tree; mist low on the ground.
prey.light: a single warm lantern and the last orange sunset light against deep violet forest shadow.

lairs.page: Lairs and world bosses (the Coiled Isle, Tidebound Grotto)
lairs.scene: a vast sea cave lair on a tropical isle — the Tidebound Grotto: jade-green stone walls, ruined naga architecture with curved serpent-like arches and old bronze fittings covered in coral and barnacles; a shallow tidal pool with bioluminescent teal water at the centre; at the focal point a broken naga altar on a raised rock with a coiled serpent statue made of jade stone; a shaft of moonlight falls through a hole in the cave ceiling onto the altar; seaweed and wet rocks in the calm foreground.
lairs.light: a cool moonbeam and teal bioluminescent water against deep jade-black shadow, one small warm bronze glint.

lost.page: 404 — page not found ("this page fell in battle")
lost.scene: a ruined battlefield at dusk after the battle: churned muddy ground with abandoned shields, broken spears and a smashed wooden catapult; a tattered plain red banner hangs from a broken pole; at the focal point on a low hill a ruined stone watchtower still smoulders with a thin column of smoke; dark storm clouds with a band of red-orange sunset behind.
lost.light: red-orange sunset glow and ember light against cold grey-brown shadow.

wow.page: World of Warcraft hub (overview of Azeroth)
wow.scene: a sweeping vista of Azeroth at sunrise from a high rocky overlook: a winding road leads down into a wide green valley with forests and a river; on a lakeshore in the middle distance rises a great white-walled human city with tall blue-roofed towers and a central keep; snowy mountain peaks beyond; on the overlook in the left foreground an old weathered stone waymarker without carvings and a lone pine in shadow.
wow.light: warm golden sunrise light on the city and the peaks against cool blue morning shadow in the valley.
